description: 断面交通量データ提供API [roads, bridges and tunnels] is a dataset listed in G-spatial Information Center (G空間情報センター), Japan, an open data portal, published or maintained by 一般社団法人　社会基盤情報流通推進協議会. 全国の都道府県警察が車両感知器などの計測機器で収集した断面交通量に関する情報を警察庁が取りまとめ、（公財）日本道路交通情報センター（JARTIC）が提供しています。 このAPIサービスは、月・都道府県毎にファイル化された断面交通量データを任意の時間・箇所で抽出できるAPIサービスです。 本サービスの特長は次の通りです。 ---------... Coverage: Japan. The portal files it under the publisher 一般社団法人　社会基盤情報流通推進協議会. Its tags are API, トラカンデータ, 交通量, 断面交通量. It offers 5 resource(s) in api, dprev, pdf. The portal shows 2024-10-05 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is the data owner's own terms of use (see the dataset page). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-gsi-portal.
